mentions.name: Cardcast
mentions.description: A webcam-based way to play Magic: The Gathering online with friends: point a webcam down at your desk and play with paper cards over a video call, specifically tailored toward Magic and Commander. Recent work focuses on marketing, bug fixes, and community building, including social media, icon design, and printing Cardcast-branded Magic cards to hand out at local TCGs.

mentions.name: CardCast
mentions.description: A webcam-based platform for playing Magic: The Gathering online with friends. It features automated card tracking that scans and identifies cards on a set interval without manual clicks, uses computer vision for card recognition, and runs on LiveKit for its video infrastructure.
mentions.problem: Spelltable has been neglected by WotC and lacked the features the author wanted for online MTG play.
